free.ways.title: Free ways to file
free.way.clinicBody: Volunteers do your return for you. Walk in, drop off your papers, or book a time in person or by video or phone.
free.way.simpleBody: A free CRA service for lower incomes: online with or without an invitation, by phone or on paper with one. For 2025 returns, the income limit in {province} is {limit} (ages 15 to 64).
free.way.simpleBody65: A free CRA service for lower incomes: online with or without an invitation, by phone or on paper with one. For 2025 returns, the income limit in {province} is {limit} (ages 65 and up).
free.way.simpleBodyGeneric: A free CRA service for people with a lower income and a simple tax situation. File online with or without an invitation; by phone or on paper with one.
free.way.softwareBody: Most certified software does a basic return for free if your income is modest, and files it online with NETFILE. NETFILE is open until {closes} for returns up to {last}.
free.way.prefilledBody: Starting {month}, the CRA will invite {millions} million eligible people to file a pre-filled return in their CRA account.
